title: 原6518引用後續：目前真binding完整reader仍超5秒，既有索引內狹義SQL效率修正
summary: Narrow successor of archived TELEMETRY-BINDING-READ-CAPACITY-20261011 (PR #6518) and TELEMETRY-BINDING-READ-CAPACITY-CURRENT-20261012 (merged PR #6525 commit 714289cf8). Direct coordinator readonly evaluation of merged 714289cf8 against production telemetry DB confirmed rb-2480fb4d26884cfdb4d6ed9202172683 still times out > 5s (limit 100=5.068s, limit 50=5.077s). Branch isolation revealed Branch 1 (payload->>'binding_id' = $1) alone times out at 5.074s due to ~186,546 rows requiring BitmapHeapScan and Sort over ~460MB payload, while Branch 2 alone completes in 0.047s. Guard refinement (payload->>'binding_id' || '') IS NULL ensures Branch 2 cleanly bypasses btree index on NULLs. Net production diff remains exactly +1 line vs baseline f5b8163fd7f333d116ec15176e73d019797e6bcc. All 146 tests pass. AC2 and AC6 remain honestly marked as pending_delivery pending independent coordinator proof.

cause_and_solution_proof.disjointness_proof: Branch 1 filter contains payload->>'binding_id' = $1 (requiring binding_id to match string parameter $1, non-null). Branch 2 filter contains (payload->>'binding_id' || '') IS NULL. Because a JSONB field cannot be simultaneously a string value and NULL, the sets of events satisfying Branch 1 and Branch 2 are strictly disjoint (b1 ∩ b2 = ∅). Zero duplicate rows can exist between the two branches.

branch_isolation_and_bottleneck_finding.b1_cause: rb-2480fb4d26884cfdb4d6ed9202172683 has ~186,546 rows in telemetry_events. idx_telemetry_events_binding_id indexes only binding_id (not created_at). PostgreSQL must read ~186,546 rows from heap and sort them by created_at DESC, ingested_seq DESC. Reading ~460MB and sorting takes ~4.96s CPU/IO, exceeding the 5.0s query timeout.
branch_isolation_and_bottleneck_finding.b2_barrier: (payload->>'binding_id' || '') IS NULL semantically equates to IS NULL across all JSONB types while fencing out idx_telemetry_events_binding_id on NULLs, forcing GIN bitmap index scan.

capacity_counter_finding.cause_status: Cause established via branch isolation (B1 times out at 5.074s; B2 returns 0 in 0.047s). Candidate published for independent coordinator readonly proof. AC2 remains pending_delivery.
